objects.name: inventory_reservations

objects.name: inventory_runes

objects.name: level_up_rewards
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE level_up_rewards (

            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

            reached_level INTEGER NOT NULL,

objects.name: location_travels
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE location_travels (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        from_node TEXT NOT NULL,
        to_node TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
            CHECK(status IN ('active','arrived','cancelled','failed')),
        revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision >= 1),
        started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        arrival_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        cancelled_at TEXT,
        completed_at TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        CHECK(from_node <> to_node),
        FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

objects.name: player_activity_sessions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE player_activity_sessions (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                activity_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
                    activity_type IN ('trade_request','trade','duel_request','pvp_battle')
                ),
                reference_id INTEGER NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                expires_at TEXT NULL,
                FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
            )

objects.name: player_interaction_requests
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE player_interaction_requests (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            request_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(request_type IN ('trade','duel')),
            initiator_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            recipient_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            location_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(
                status IN ('pending','accepted','declined','cancelled','expired')
            ),
            revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            responded_at TEXT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(initiator_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            FOREIGN KEY(recipient_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            CHECK(initiator_user_id <> recipient_user_id)
        )

objects.name: player_trade_events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE player_trade_events (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            trade_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            actor_user_id INTEGER NULL,
            event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(trade_id) REFERENCES player_trades(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

objects.name: player_trade_history
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE player_trade_history (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            trade_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            initiator_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            recipient_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('completed','cancelled','expired','failed')),
            initiator_offer_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            recipient_offer_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            summary_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            completed_at TEXT NULL,
            cancelled_at TEXT NULL,
            cancel_reason TEXT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(trade_id) REFERENCES player_trades(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

objects.name: player_trade_offers
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE player_trade_offers (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            trade_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            asset_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(asset_type IN ('stack','equipment','gold')),
            inventory_id INTEGER NULL,
            item_id INTEGER NULL,
            quantity INTEGER NULL,
            gold_amount REAL NULL,
            snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(trade_id) REFERENCES player_trades(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
            CHECK(quantity IS NULL OR quantity > 0),
            CHECK(gold_amount IS NULL OR gold_amount >= 0)
        )

objects.name: player_trades
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE player_trades (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            request_id INTEGER NULL UNIQUE,
            initiator_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            recipient_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            location_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'editing' CHECK(
                status IN ('editing','confirming','committing','completed','cancelled','expired','failed')
            ),
            revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            initiator_ready INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(initiator_ready IN (0,1)),
            recipient_ready INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(recipient_ready IN (0,1)),
            initiator_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(initiator_confirmed IN (0,1)),
            recipient_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(recipient_confirmed IN (0,1)),
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            completed_at TEXT NULL,
            cancelled_at TEXT NULL,
            cancel_reason TEXT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(request_id) REFERENCES player_interaction_requests(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(initiator_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
            FOREIGN KEY(recipient_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
            CHECK(initiator_user_id <> recipient_user_id)
        )

objects.name: premium_item_grants
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE premium_item_grants(


   id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0),

   FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT


  )

objects.name: pve_encounters
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE pve_encounters (
        encounter_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, deadline_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', terminal_reason TEXT DEFAULT '',
        terminal_at TEXT DEFAULT NULL, mob_snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        CHECK(status IN ('active','victory','defeat','manual_escape','auto_escape','replaced'))
    )

objects.name: pvp_battles
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE pvp_battles (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                request_id INTEGER,
                challenger_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                opponent_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'waiting'
                    CHECK(status IN ('waiting','active','resolving','completed','cancelled','expired')),
                round_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(round_number >= 1),
                revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision >= 1),
                resolving INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(resolving IN (0,1)),
                action_deadline TEXT,
                winner_id INTEGER,
                result_reason TEXT,
                max_rounds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 CHECK(max_rounds >= 1),
                action_timeout_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20 CHECK(action_timeout_seconds >= 1),
                state_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                completed_at TEXT,
                CHECK(challenger_id <> opponent_id)
            )

objects.name: pvp_events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE pvp_events (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                battle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                round_number INTEGER,
                revision INTEGER,
                event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                actor_id INTEGER,
                target_id INTEGER,
                payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                FOREIGN KEY (battle_id) REFERENCES pvp_battles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
            )

objects.name: pvp_participants
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE pvp_participants (
                battle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                side TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(side IN ('challenger','opponent')),
                class_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                max_hp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(max_hp >= 1),
                hp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(hp >= 0),
                max_mp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(max_mp >= 0),
                mp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(mp >= 0),
                resource_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                resource_value INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                combo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(combo >= 0),
                consecutive_afk INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(consecutive_afk >= 0),
                stunned_next INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(stunned_next IN (0,1)),
                cooldowns_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
                effects_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
                snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (battle_id, user_id),
                UNIQUE (battle_id, side),
                FOREIGN KEY (battle_id) REFERENCES pvp_battles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
            )

objects.name: pvp_round_actions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE pvp_round_actions (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                action_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action_type IN ('basic_attack','skill','afk_skip','stunned_skip')),
                skill_key TEXT,
                payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
                submitted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE (battle_id, round_number, user_id),
                FOREIGN KEY (battle_id) REFERENCES pvp_battles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
            )
